deliverables: Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
Planned Eternl Core, Eternl Hub, hardware wallet support, and wallet data export improvements
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, improvements, infrastructure, support, administration, and audits/oversight.

claims.claim: Eternl asks for ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover a 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027.
The proposal states Eternl costs around $420,000 per year and funds 6.0 FTE across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl plans to introduce Pro plans priced at $96 per year for personal users and $360 per year for companies, and says about 5,500 paying users would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
The proposer states Eternl has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.
The proposer commits to convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

The proposal says independent audits by a party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or the Eternl team will occur in February 2027 and August 2027 and review custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and treasury refunds or repayments.

The proposer commits to semiannual repayment checks in December and June, using surplus treasury stablecoins plus paid plan income above $420,000 to repay up to the full $420,000 received value, and potentially donate up to an additional $210,000 if income exceeds thresholds.
The proposal states every paid Pro plan will be recorded on-chain with metadata and that reports on Pro plan earnings plus repayment or donation transaction hashes will be published.
The proposer claims 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.

The proposal states Eternl previously received Catalyst grants, an Intersect grant, and a 2025 treasury withdrawal of ₳583,000, and says the 2025 funding is about $153,000 short due to Ada price decline.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for a 12-month Eternl sustainability plan, with a proposed Pro-plan path to self-funding, public-wallet custody, repayment mechanics, and independent fund-use audits, but several adoption and cost claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the document.
